name: Shipping update
subject: Your coffee is on its way
preheader: Order KW-20418 left the roastery today. Harbour Post expects to deliver it on Friday 23 October.
summary: Sent when the parcel is handed to the carrier, with tracking and a delivery estimate.

footer.reason: You are getting this email because you placed an order with Kettlewick. It is a service message about that order.

tip.title: Give it until Saturday
tip.text: Coffee needs a few days after roasting to settle. Keep the bag sealed and out of the sun, and open it from Saturday for the sweetest cup.
